info.title: v2.order.get_pending_buyer_invoice_order_list
info.description: This endpoint only for PH and BR local sellers only. This API is used for seller to retrieve a list of order IDs that are pending invoice upload.

get.description: This endpoint only for PH and BR local sellers only. This API is used for seller to retrieve a list of order IDs that are pending invoice upload.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/order/get_pending_buyer_invoice_order_list?access_token=access_token&cursor=%22%22&page_size=10&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
